relevance_note: Single case report of a boy whose WES "identified the heterozygous variant c.1420A>G (p.Thr474Ala) in exon7 of the TNFAIP3 gene" with suspected AISBL.
method_note: Hand-built with a short Python script from my own reading of the paper; every span checked verbatim by script. Scope: one in-scope person (the case-report patient, label 'patient'). The eight siblings (untested, 'none of whom have any significant medical history') and parents (not tested) are not described as tested or affected, so they get no rows. The 14 Zhou et al. cases and the Shin et al. ITP/Behcet patient in the Discussion are given only at group level or have no TNFAIP3 variant, so no rows. Contradiction: the Case presentation reports 'a history of mild epistaxis' and 'recurrent epistaxis and ecchymosis', while the Discussion says 'Our patient did not report any history of bleeding in the past'; both rows emitted (epistaxis observed; any history of bleeding excluded). Not a checklist item. Age 12 is the age at first presentation to the authors' centre (April 2017); follow-up continued past September 2019, so age at report may be higher; recorded 12 from the abstract wording. Age 9 is both the age at ITP diagnosis and 'first presentation'. In silico predictions ('10 of 16 bioinformatics in silico programs predict a pathogenic') are not a functional assay, so functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported'. Variant type 'missense' rests on 'which leads to an amino acid exchange'; the word missense is not printed. No build given for chr6:138200002. Normal examinations as a whole ('musculoskeletal system examination was normal'; ophthalmology/immunology/rheumatology consultations with 'no significant findings') are recorded as written and exclude nothing more specific; so uveitis and arthritis/arthralgia stay not reported. 'no history of ... joint involvement' sits in the bleeding history (may mean haemarthrosis), so checklist arthritis or arthralgia left not reported. No lymphadenopathy and no organomegaly do not exclude the broader 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy' item; left not reported. The Discussion sentence 'Our case did not report any such features' (after Zhou et al.'s feature list) is ambiguous in reference and was not used for exclusions. Checklist 'skin lesions' marked observed on vitiligo; 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' observed on immune thrombocytopenia.
